'''Yde''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Monsters">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref> located in the [[Yde system/Legends|Yde system]], a part of the [[Nicandra sector/Legends|Nicandra sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA Yde" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yde was first mentioned in the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of [[George Lucas]], creator of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, with original text by [[Bob Carrau]]. In the book, Yde was introduced as an astronomical object that was the site of the location [[Desultori]]. The latter was given as the home of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] inventor and [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Aanxi Raanxi Laanxi]], who chaired four subcommittees for the [[University of Desultori]].<ref name="Monsters" />

[[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in ''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas'' is [[Canon|non-canonical]]<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref> with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> However, [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref> co-author of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the existence of Yde to be canonical with respect to the Legends continuity.<ref name="Fry" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the Yde system in grid square M-7.<ref name="TEA Yde" />
